Players Committee card image of [[Captain Phasma (Remastered 2025)|Captain Phasma (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “Adds one battle destiny with a stormtrooper. If you just won a battle at same or related location, may retrieve a trooper.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/captainphasma.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/5637ac69a300a13ed3aa4df39631e5415498a42e 5637ac6] (12 December 2025). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
